description: This file defines an interface for data access operations related to TaxRate entities within the sales manager system. It extends generic DAO capabilities and provides specific methods for querying tax rates based on store, location, and tax class.

classes.name: TaxRateDao
classes.description: Interface for Data Access Object handling TaxRate entities, including custom query methods for retrieving tax rates based on various parameters.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves tax rates filtered by country, state or province, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a tax rate by its unique code within the context of a specific merchant store.

calls: SalesManagerEntityDao<Long, TaxRate>. (methods inherited from parent interface)
